svg.text: Route: /admin/products · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin only (admin site, signed in)
• Search matches name or category and works together with the category filter. With no match: “No products match … ” and a Clear search / Show all categories button.
• Recipe: how many raw materials the dish's bill of materials has, “No recipe yet” (the dish is sold out until it gets one), or “Ready-made (pieces)” for an item in the Ready-made
category. Servings / pieces: what the raw materials can make, or a ready-made item's pieces.
• + Add product and Edit open the product form (12b, 12c, 12e); Delete asks first (12d). After a save a confirmation bar appears above the table. Bulk import opens 16.
